metadata.title: ProdTerra
metadata.description: Plan your farm's plantings with NASA satellite data.

locate.title: Where is your farm?
locate.hint: Search for your town or use your location. Then move the map until your land is in the center.
locate.noResults: We couldn't find that place. Try the name of the town or district.
locate.searchFailed: Search didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
locate.locationDenied: There's no permission to see your location. Search for it by name.
locate.locationUnavailable: We couldn't find your location. Search for it by name.

boundary.title: Mark the edge of your farm
boundary.hint: Tap each corner of the land, one at a time. When you have them all, tap “Close farm”.
boundary.drawingHint: Tap each corner of your farm.
boundary.closeRequirement: Mark at least 3 corners to close the farm.
boundary.tooLarge: The marked area is over the {maximum} ha ProdTerra supports. Zoom in and mark only the edge of the farm.
boundary.tooSmall: It looks like it closed too early. Mark the farm corners again.

lots.title: Split your farm into lots
lots.hint: Mark each part where you grow something different. A lot can't go outside the farm or overlap another lot.
lots.lotCount: {count, plural, =0 {No lots} one {# lot} other {# lots}}
lots.drawingHint: Tap each corner of the lot.
lots.empty: No lots yet. Mark the first one on the map.
lots.closeRequirement: Mark at least 3 corners to close the lot.

redrawDialog.title: Mark the farm again?
redrawDialog.description: The farm edge and {count, plural, =0 {}one {the lot you marked} other {the # lots you marked}} will be deleted. This can’t be undone.

rejection.outsideFarmTitle: The lot goes outside the farm
rejection.outsideFarm: Mark the lot inside the yellow line, which is the edge of your farm.
rejection.overlapsLot: This lot covers part of {lotName}. Mark it in a free part of the farm.

lots.farmFull: The whole farm is already in lots. Delete a lot if you want to mark it differently.
lots.lotLimit: You already marked {maximum} lots, the most the calendar supports.

split.title: Split into equal parts
split.hint: All lots have the same area and follow the longest side of the farm. You can rename or delete them afterwards.

replaceDialog.title: Replace your lots?
replaceDialog.description: {count, plural, one {The lot you marked will be deleted} other {The # lots you marked will be deleted}} and the farm will be split into equal parts.

summary.title: Your farm at a glance
summary.intro: The key facts about your land, before planning the crops.
summary.failedTitle: We couldn't load your farm's climate
summary.failed: Check your internet connection and try again. You can't move on to the next step without this data.
summary.rainChartLabel: Rain each month in liters per square meter. The driest month is {driestMonth}, with about {driestValue} liters per m², and the wettest is {wettestMonth}, with about {wettestValue}.
summary.sourcesTitle: Where does this data come from?
summary.landSource: Land: calculated from your drawing over Esri World Imagery satellite imagery.
summary.estimateNote: These values are estimates based on satellite data and do not replace the farmer's own knowledge of the farm.
summary.gridElevationRow: Elevation of the area NASA POWER measures (~50 km)
summary.adjustmentExplanation: The farm is {difference} {direction, select, colder {higher} other {lower}} than that area. Air changes 6.5 °C for every 1,000 m of elevation (U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976).

crops.title: What do you grow in each lot?
crops.hint: Tap a lot and answer 4 questions. We use them to build your calendar.
crops.allDone: Done: we have what we need to build your calendar.
crops.applyToAll: Use these answers for every lot
crops.catalogFailed: We couldn't get the crop list. Check your internet connection and try again.

calendar.title: Your calendar
calendar.hint: How each lot looks over the next 12 months. Every day is painted by its status.
calendar.loading: Building the plan with NASA data…
calendar.failed: Check your internet connection and try again.
calendar.demoNotice: This calendar uses test data for crop and pest ranges.
calendar.lotsGridLabel: Status of each lot per day in {month}
calendar.rowSummary: {lot}: {crop}, {status, select, ok {all fine} watch {watch} other {risk}} this month
calendar.alarmsEmpty: No lot needs attention this month.

alarm.temperature: Average temperature of {value} °C, outside what the crop tolerates.
alarm.drought: Without irrigation about {value} liters of water per m² are missing.
alarm.irrigation: Irrigate about {value} liters per m² this month.
alarm.pest: Watch for {pest}: this month's weather favors it.

lotPlan.title: Plan for {lot}
lotPlan.estimatedCycle: We don't have this crop's cycle; it was estimated at 3 months.
lotPlan.noClimate: There is no climate data for this lot.

reason.sameFamily: It belongs to the same family as the previous crop, which favors soil pests and diseases.
reason.differentFamily: It belongs to a different family than the previous crop.
reason.sameNutrient: It uses the same main nutrient ({nutrient}) as the previous crop.
reason.differentNutrient: It mainly uses another nutrient ({nutrient}), so the soil recovers.
reason.highAfterHighDemand: It is another demanding crop in a row.
reason.restAfterHighDemand: It asks less of the soil after a demanding crop.
reason.afterRest: The soil comes from a rest period.
reason.unknownHistory: We don't know what was there before, so rotation couldn't be checked.
reason.altitudeOutOfRange: It doesn't grow well at this lot's elevation.
reason.climateFit: The climate suits it {suitable} of {total} months of the cycle.
reason.pestMonths: The weather favors pests in {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} of the cycle.
reason.waitForBetterMonth: It is better to wait {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} to sow, when the weather suits it better.
